title: Retry after HTTP 429
assignment: Reconstruct two attempts on the virtual timeline. Check Retry-After compliance. Describe how to preserve the first error after receiving the second attempt's final response; do not delete it from analysis of a successful series.
questions: What is the earliest permitted virtual time for a retry request?
How many requests started, and how many failed? Why cannot they be reduced to one successful attempt?
Which retry limits does a real client need: budget, attempt count, deadline?
Can 1200 virtual milliseconds be treated as measured inference latency or zero cost?
